text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I walked into the trainer's 
office... only to find it crammed with 
exercise equipment that I had no idea how 
to use.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer. Good day to you♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see... I've gained a bit of 
weight, so I looked up some diet 
equipment... but to my surprise, there are 
an overwhelming number of options.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So, I thought I'd just give it a try, and 
bought one of everything♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's start with this one that 
uses electricity to jiggle your stomach!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what would happen if we used this 
somewhere other than the stomach...? 
Trainer, why don't you try it on your 
cheek!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, this is amazing! This zero-gravity 
treadmill thing is so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Satono Diamond had a blast messing 
around with the exercise equipment and 
ended up losing weight as a result.
